notes: Utah's 2026 taxpayer tax credit now phases out from the Tax Commission's published 2026 base of $18,696 for a single filer (Utah Legislature interim committee, Sep 16, 2026) instead of the retained 2025 base of $18,213. The credit is $966 minus 1.3% of Utah taxable income above that base, so the fix is worth at most $6.28/year and only for Utah filers with taxable income between $18,213 and about $93,000. Everyone else's estimate is unchanged; with a pay stub saved, nothing changes.
